what: Coverage of the two verify.ps1 game-state checksums (deterministicChecksum, viewInvariantChecksum), re-measured on current main because the addresses quoted in the Issue #296 body were taken against PR #292 and the tree has since been cut several times (PR #300, #305, #308, #309).

findings.claim: scripts/verify.ps1 never passes --prototype to the scenario runner
deterministicChecksum comes from Invoke-Scenario's non-prototype run, assigned in the sim stage
without --prototype, Program.cs runs SimulationScenario.Run over SimulationWorld and prints result.Checksum as scenario_result.checksum
viewInvariantChecksum comes from the godot stage's four-camera-case comparison
the compared checksum is PrototypeWorld state, assigned once in Main.Session.cs via PrototypeScenario.Capture(_world)

liveExample.reason: Issue #281's partition contains no file on the SimulationScenario.Run path; SimulationWorld is untouched by construction, so no mutant inside Main.cs or PrototypeWorld.cs could move deterministicChecksum.

corroboratingValues.note: The same deterministicChecksum and viewInvariantChecksum values quoted in the Issue #281 body still match a full verify.ps1 run recorded on 2026-08-07 for a different issue (#287), consistent with deterministicChecksum being blind to the #281 partition.
